<b>Karakas</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are members of the [[Order of Karak]], long lost to time and living on only in memory.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Karakas cannot walk and can only move or reposition themselves with the moves below.<br>
* <b>Sprint:</b> Sprints towards Hornet for a set distance, though it will shorten it to prevent making contact with her. Only used to pursue Hornet if she's out of range for all other attacks.
* <b>Dash:</b> Dashes either forward or backwards a set distance to reposition or get closer to Hornet.
* <b>Jump:</b> Jumps either forwards or backwards, performing a downwards slash as they land from a forwards jump if Hornet is in range. The forwards jump is often used to pursue Hornet.
* <b>Slash:</b> Readies their blade horizontally, then slashes outwards.
* <b>Overhead Slash:</b> Readies their blade above their head, then does a large overhead slash.
* <b>Block:</b> Holds their blade in front of themselves, and blocks any [[Needle]] attack from that side. Immediately retaliates with any of the attacks above if their guard is struck.

All of the their blade attacks deal {{Damage|2}}, while contact damage deals only {{Damage|1}}.

== Location ==
Karakas can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
